description: Source code for format utilities in ANGLE project, translating GL image formats to D3D11 formats, including support checks, format size info, and vertex format info for different feature levels.

classes.name: DXGIFormatSize
classes.description: Stores size information for a DXGI format, including pixel bytes, block width, and block height.

classes.name: VertexFormat
classes.description: Defines vertex format details including conversion type, native DXGI format, and copy function.

methods.name: SupportsMipGen
methods.description: Checks if a DXGI format supports mipmap auto-generation at a given feature level.

methods.name: GetDXGIFormatSizeInfo
methods.description: Returns size info for a given DXGI format.

methods.name: GetVertexFormatInfo
methods.description: Retrieves vertex format info based on format ID and feature level.

methods.name: GetVertexFormatInfo_FL_9_3
methods.description: Provides vertex format info specific to D3D11 feature level 9_3.
